summary: Phase 55 (admission-number login, cross-identifier lockout, admin unlock, password eye toggle) tested end-to-end on Sunrise/TEST. All 12 pytests pass (test_phase55_login.py 5/5, test_phase47.py 7/7). Frontend verified: eye toggle on branded login (type password<->text, aria-label 'Show password'<->'Hide password', type=button, value preserved, re-hides on submit); admission SPS-001 and sps-001 login succeed on /login/sunrise desktop + mobile 390; email login still works; generic /login with SPS-001 shows 'Use your school's login link, or sign in with your email'; /login/p50demo with SPS-001 returns 'Invalid credentials'. Lockout verified: 5 bad attempts mixing email and admission number returns 429 on both identifiers. Admin UI: Users list at /app/users shows locked-badge-<uid> 'Locked — unlocks at HH:MM' on aarav row and unlock-row-<uid> action on locked rows only; clicking unlock clears badge and aarav logs in immediately with Sunrise@2026. OpenAPI exposes /api/account-locks, /api/account-locks/{uid}, /api/account-locks/{uid}/unlock. Aarav ends unlocked with password Sunrise@2026 (verified 200 at the end).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is >13000 lines — scoping and lock helpers for Phase 55 are fine, but overall file is well past the 700-line rule and should be modularised (auth, account-locks, students, etc.) in a dedicated refactor.
Login has per-account lockout only; no per-IP limiter (OTP endpoints have one). Consider a shared per-IP throttle for /api/auth/login to blunt distributed brute-force.
Platform admin unlock path is backend-only (platform UI has no school-admin list). Fine for now — note already in agent-to-agent context.
